extraction: Verbatim transcription of the published LaTeX table. No unit conversion, no derivation, no cross-table join.
note: Herbonnet+2020 (MNRAS 497, 4684), "CCCP and MENeaCS: (updated) weak-lensing masses for 100 galaxy clusters". This is the PUBLISHED version of the weak-lensing masses that Ettori+2019 used for their X-COP comparison via private communication (cited there as "Herbonnet et al. 2018, in prep."). M200_NFW/M500_NFW are from NFW fitting; R500_ap/M500_ap are from the deprojected aperture-mass method. Masses and radii scale as h70^-1. NOTE: the X-COP overlap subset has NOT been identified or joined here - that requires a deliberate, verified name match against the 13 clusters in ettori2019_xcop_hydrostatic_masses.tsv.
